description: Public-safe evaluation cases for Supericons Semantic Search v2. These fixtures protect exact search, long natural-language concepts, localized concepts, negative meaning separation, recommendation slots, library behavior, and shared query understanding before production ranking changes.
review_policy: Public-safe seeds may enter the candidate suite, but expected families and unacceptable results require owner review before they count toward a release gate.

query_groups.purpose: Protect exact AI and developer tool logo discovery.
Measure whether long phrases resolve to useful visual families instead of weak standalone words.
